posts.title: Stop Feeding the Beast
posts.description: Product people were always trusted with the company's scarcest resource, the developers. With AI, what's scarce has changed, but the habit of protecting developers' time hasn't, and now it works against the team.

posts.title: Clarity Isn’t Coming
posts.description: Everyone comes to product people with things to act on, and given the load you carry, it makes sense to wait until they become clearer. But they can't become clearer without you leading them there, so waiting isn't going to help.

posts.title: When Numbers Work Against You
posts.description: Good leaders give their teams clear goals. And what's clearer than a number? The problem is that a number does help the team focus, but not necessarily on the right things. If you want the number to stay, it can't travel alone.
